outputs: Generated text responses for question answering tasks
Generated tokens for language modeling tasks
Generated answers/tokens for QA and language modeling tasks
The paper evaluates generated outputs in tasks such as question answering and dialogue generation, including token-level generation and chat capabilities.

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as task since paper focuses on QA and language modeling, not conversational dialogue. Changed C4-En to C4 for normalization. Added Language Modeling as a task since perplexity is evaluated. Streamlined outputs descriptions.
Removed duplicate metrics (lowercase versions). Normalized 'Kullback-Leibler divergence' to 'KL divergence' and 'ROUGE-1' to 'ROUGE' following simplification rules.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The LLMs (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Phi-2) are used as generation models, not evaluators.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on LLM security/protection rather than NLG evaluation methods. It evaluates NLG outputs (QA responses, generated text) but primarily as a way to validate their protection method (TaylorMLP) maintains model performance. The evaluation is comprehensive but serves the primary goal of verifying security properties rather than proposing new evaluation methodologies.
